name: 02_energy_price_hourly_retrain_cost

dataset.display_name: Hourly Day-Ahead Electricity Prices with Exogenous Variables
dataset.split: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

business_question: When every hourly refit costs compute, which program minimizes forecast error plus the CPU cost of refitting?

seeds.source: step-60000 neural policy (Rust/Candle CPU), produced by agy_resource_fitness; see seeds.provenance.json

why: An hourly refit is paid in compute every hour, so the cost is a price per CPU second, not a cliff. A composite adds that price to scaled RMSE, and the search finds the cheapest accurate program.
caveats: Time-ordered data, but jope pipeline run validates on an unordered fold partition of train.csv, so this case does not exercise chronological (regime) validation
CPU price is illustrative; set your own cost per CPU second.
